soldier: Head of the soldier brown, the operculum of the antennal socket nearly blackish brown, eye spots pale brownish yellow; pronotum slightly paler than the head but distinctly darker than the abdomen. Setae of the frontal region stout and long, becoming slender and short posteriorly; the labrum with five or six pairs of long setae near the anterior margin, the middle pair longer; the anterior margin of the pronotum sparsely setose, the hairs of the middle region short and sparse; the mesonotal and metanotal tergites rather densely hairy; the abdomen rather densely hairy. Head capsule rectangular, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior lateral corners rounded, the inclination of the frontal region 43–45°. Fontanelle small and dot-like, the aperture diameter 0.03 mm, situated at one-quarter of the head from the front. Eye spots hardly projecting. Labrum nearly semicircular, the labral apex running straight; mandibles stout and sabre-shaped, the apex slightly curved, the outer margin almost smooth, each upper mandible with one small marginal tooth behind the mid-point of the inner margin; the left mandible about 0.42 of the head capsule length. Pronotum kidney-shaped, the anterior margin concave, the posterior margin semicircular.
